title: Breaking configuration-surface change (pre-registered before counting)
item_unit: A single changelog or release-note bullet (line starting with '-' or '*' or '1.') belonging to a dated vendor release.
break_signal_regex: \bbreaking change\b|\bbreaking:|\bremoved deprecated\b|\bno longer (reads?|honou?rs?|supports?|accepts?|loaded|loaded from)\b|\bmigrated (from|to)\b.{0,80}(settings|config|json)|\brenamed .{0,60}(settings|config|flag|env)|\bonly accept(s)? one path\b|\bdropped support\b.{0,40}(config|settings|flag)
notes: Counts labeled+mechanical config-surface breaks in published notes only. Vendors that ship silent schema breaks without matching wording are undercounted; that is a property of the notes, not a license to invent.
